column1: # Full-width share of each ASCII symbol in Japanese text, for
# symbol_width = "auto" (postprocess::auto_width) when the text before the
# caret does not show it. Embedded by postprocess.rs.
# symbol <TAB> none <TAB> one <TAB> both: the percentage written full-width
# (＂ rather than ") with no / one / two ASCII or full-width digits or
# letters right beside it, counting only symbols with kana or kanji within
# three chars. Over 50 is full-width. A case seen under 100 times takes the
# one before it (one <- none, both <- one); a symbol seen under 100 times
# with nothing beside it is half-width.
# Counted over 301M chars of raw text: fineweb2_edu 120M, hplt3 120M, whitepaper 51M, livedoor 10M.
